student_learning_goal: I can measure length and time using the right tool.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can measure length and time using the right tool.
header.character_watermark: Roo and Cal in lab coats in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Match 4 objects to the right unit (cubes/hand-spans/cm/m).
parts.visual_layout: A two-column matching layout pairing 4 objects to 4 unit choices with line-drawing.

image_placeholders.description: A two-column match for Grade 2 capstone. Left: 4 objects (paperclip, book, doorway, hallway). Right: 4 unit choices (cubes, hand-spans, cm, m).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_UNITS at Part 1: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Paperclip → cm. Book → cm/hand-spans. Doorway → m. Hallway → m.

parts.student_instructions: Measure 3 objects with a ruler. Draw a 6-cm line.
parts.visual_layout: Three object icons stacked, each with a cm answer line, plus blank space below for drawing a 6-cm line.

image_placeholders.description: 3 objects (pencil, eraser, crayon) for Grade 2 capstone, B&W line art, with cm answer lines below each. Below: blank space for drawing a 6-cm line with label '6 cm line:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_RULER at Part 2: keywords name the activity.

parts.student_instructions: Pick the right time unit for 4 events.
parts.visual_layout: Four event rows with seconds/minutes/hours options for each.

image_placeholders.description: 4 events for Grade 2 capstone. Events: 'Blink', 'Brush teeth', 'Recess', 'School day'. Each row has S/M/H circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_TIME at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Blink: S. Brush: M. Recess: M. School day: H.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write 1 measurement you made today and the unit.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Score against rubric. Part 2 includes one TRANSFER object that requires a non-zero starting point on the ruler (a picture of a pencil starting at the 2-cm mark). Verifies interval-counting transfer beyond standard 0-start measurements.
